answer: Neighbor-Quorum Bond: each new identity is an island needing five vouches. Vouches ride the river of public records: neighbors check real jobs, and a lotus blooms on the ledger at five signatures. Neighbors stake 20 credits a vouch; a fake burns stake and bond, killing the rented-neighbor ring. Forging 1,000 islands takes 5,000 vouches at 20 plus 1,000 bonds at 70: 170,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay one bond, keep their lotus.
